context: A synthetic international industrial-services company operating across European markets. Leadership needs a consistent way to prioritise AI ideas across field operations, shared services, customer service and corporate functions.
honesty: Fictional organisation, opportunities and scores created to demonstrate a transparent AI transformation decision approach. No client data is used.

initiatives.title: Automated Document Classification
initiatives.problem: High volumes of incoming documents are manually classified and routed.
initiatives.rationale: Mature technology, strong data readiness and limited decision impact make this a practical early implementation.
initiatives.nextDecision:
Approve a controlled pilot and define human exception thresholds.

90-day action:
Run a pilot on one document family, measure accuracy and routing-time reduction, then define scale criteria.
initiatives.action: Run a pilot on one document family, measure accuracy and routing-time reduction, then define scale criteria.

initiatives.title: Employee Knowledge Assistant
initiatives.problem: Employees spend significant time searching across policies, procedures and internal knowledge.
initiatives.rationale: High feasibility and visible productivity value, with manageable risks if source grounding and access controls are designed properly.
initiatives.nextDecision:
Agree trusted knowledge sources and access-control boundaries.

90-day action:
Launch a limited internal pilot with a curated knowledge base and explicit answer citations.
initiatives.action: Launch a limited internal pilot with a curated knowledge base and explicit answer citations.

initiatives.title: Invoice Anomaly Detection
initiatives.problem: Manual controls do not efficiently identify unusual invoice patterns.
initiatives.rationale: Strong data availability and a clear human-review process make the use case suitable for controlled implementation.
initiatives.risks: false positives; investigator fatigue; data drift.
initiatives.nextDecision:
Define anomaly thresholds and ownership of investigation.

90-day action:
Back-test on historical invoices and establish a human-in-the-loop review workflow.
initiatives.action: Back-test on historical invoices and establish a human-in-the-loop review workflow.

initiatives.title: Customer Service Knowledge Assistant
initiatives.problem: Service teams need faster access to consistent product and process information.
initiatives.rationale: Business value is strong, but adoption and answer quality require careful rollout and coaching.
initiatives.risks: incorrect guidance; inconsistent adoption; reliance on incomplete knowledge.
initiatives.nextDecision:
Decide whether the first release is advisor-only or customer-facing.

90-day action:
Pilot internally with service agents, track answer usefulness and escalation rates, and refine content ownership.
initiatives.action: Pilot internally with service agents, track answer usefulness and escalation rates, and refine content ownership.

initiatives.title: Contract Review Assistant
initiatives.problem: Teams spend substantial time identifying standard clauses, deviations and review points.
initiatives.rationale: Potential productivity value is significant, but legal reliance and accountability require stronger oversight before operational use.
initiatives.nextDecision:
Define which review tasks may be assisted and which remain mandatory human decisions.

90-day action:
Run a sandbox evaluation on historical contracts with legal reviewers and compare assistant findings to expert review.
initiatives.action: Run a sandbox evaluation on historical contracts with legal reviewers and compare assistant findings to expert review.

initiatives.title: Sustainability Reporting Assistant
initiatives.problem: Reporting teams repeatedly search guidance, consolidate narrative evidence and explain data variances.
initiatives.rationale: The use case has clear productivity potential, but source-data quality and reporting accountability need further validation.
initiatives.risks: unsupported narrative generation; inconsistent source data; auditability.
initiatives.nextDecision:
Define which reporting tasks are assistive versus authoritative.

90-day action:
Prototype evidence retrieval and narrative drafting on one reporting topic with mandatory source linking.
initiatives.action: Prototype evidence retrieval and narrative drafting on one reporting topic with mandatory source linking.

initiatives.title: Predictive Asset Maintenance
initiatives.problem: Maintenance is still partly calendar-based rather than driven by failure probability.
initiatives.rationale: Strategic and operational value is high, but sensor-data readiness and changes to maintenance planning need validation.
initiatives.risks: weak historical failure data; false predictions; frontline trust.
initiatives.nextDecision:
Choose one asset class with sufficient data for a proof of value.

90-day action:
Assess historical maintenance/sensor data, build a baseline model and test how recommendations fit current planning processes.
initiatives.action: Assess historical maintenance/sensor data, build a baseline model and test how recommendations fit current planning processes.

initiatives.title: AI-Supported Recruitment Screening
initiatives.problem: High application volumes create screening workload and inconsistent early-stage triage.
initiatives.rationale: Although technically feasible, employment-related decision impact, bias risk and regulatory exposure make this lower priority than safer opportunities.
initiatives.risks: discrimination; explainability; regulatory non-compliance; inappropriate automation of employment decisions.
initiatives.nextDecision:
Decide whether any low-risk assistive HR use case could address the underlying workload without automated candidate screening.

90-day action:
Do not implement screening automation. Reframe toward administrative assistance or candidate-information support and reassess.
initiatives.action: Do not implement screening automation. Reframe toward administrative assistance or candidate-information support and reassess.
